title.narrative: Human-Centered Digital Transformation: Opportunities, Risks and Inclusive Governance in Mexico

description.narrative: Digital technologies, particularly artificial intelligence (AI), are reshaping societies, economies and public institutions across Mexico. While these technologies offer significant opportunities to improve access to knowledge, public services, innovation and participation, they also raise challenges related to human rights, inclusion, well-being, privacy, discrimination, digital dependency and governance. Building on UNESCO’s mandate on the ethical governance of technology and social transformations, this initiative will support knowledge generation, policy dialogue, capacity-building and/or awareness-raising on the societal implications of digital transformation. Particular attention may be given to priority areas such as education, mental health and well-being, public administration, justice systems, youth engagement, digital inclusion and emerging technologies. Through evidence generation, stakeholder engagement and policy support, the initiative will contribute to more inclusive, responsible and human-centered digital transformation processes in Mexico, aligned with UNESCO’s ethical approach to digital development.
